agent_readiness.notes: robots.txt is 'User-agent: * / crawl-delay: 5' with no disallow, so all AI and search crawlers are allowed (the 5s delay is polite but harmless). Maps place has the contractor category, address, phone, hours and a veteran-owned attribute, though it still prompts for missing info and photos. The site gives readable service lists, brands, service area ('greater Central New Jersey') and free-estimate language, but no structured data of any kind and no price ranges. The quote form is labelled, has a real service dropdown and no CAPTCHA - the best booking posture in this batch, marred only by the wrong tel: link.

operations_signals.signal: Free estimates for 'any job big or small' means high inquiry volume with manual qualification; the form captures service type but not property type, timeline or budget
All contact routes to a Gmail address and one mobile number, with no CRM or scheduling visible
A wrong-number call link suggests the site is edited without a QA pass after template reuse (inference from the mismatched tel: link)

scores.reasons: A functioning site with a real quote form, so the gaps are sharp but fixable (wrong phone link, no schema, missing profile details); window/door replacement jobs are high-ticket for a small crew; fixes are fast; verified by opening home, contact, robots and the Maps place directly.

caveats: Ratings come from the Google Maps place panel; that panel rendered a 'limited view' in this browser and did not display review counts, so review counts are 'not shown' except where a third-party profile stated one.
Several businesses are single-owner/micro operations (H & J, Zanco, Bomb Balloon); staff counts and customer mix are inferences from address type and review volume, not published facts.
No forms were submitted anywhere in this batch; findings about forms are based on field labels and page structure only.
data_gaps: Google Maps limited view showed ratings but not review counts for all businesses (only H & J had a count, from Birdeye).
DuckDuckGo returned a bot CAPTCHA and Google web search demanded sign-in, so listing data was read from Google Maps place pages opened by name+address search.

The browser was shared with other agents and tabs were switched mid-session; phone-width layouts were therefore verified mainly by measuring document width against a 390px viewport, with phone screenshots captured for Shawki, Midland, AMBNJ and Dental Arts Studio only.

Zanco Footwear has no Google Maps place and no recent activity signal; trading status could not be confirmed. Bomb Balloon Company is marked 'Temporarily closed' on Google with no phone/hours/website on the profile.
Facebook/Instagram presences for H & J, Zanco and Bomb Balloon could not be confirmed in search results, so possible social-only marketing is unknown.
No pricing or rate information is published by any of the professional-services businesses, so price ranges are unknown for all.
